verdicts.reason: Both share the same serious flaws. The 'Pick your sound' eyebrow is moved to the far right, after the headline, so the reading order is wrong. The earbuds case is reduced to two dots stuck between the CTA and a label. The product labels no longer sit with their products ('Obsidian Buds, $179' is under the headphones, 'Obsidian One' is beside the bud dots). An orphaned empty grey ellipse floats at the right. A's headline is a little larger but crowds right up against the headphones, while B leaves a cleaner gap between the headphones and the copy block, so B is marginally better.
